blocks.html: Talenti Team member responsible for products and technological innovation. Certified Scrum Master and Agile Coach, an expert in leadership, management, and Agile methodologies and processes. Co-founder of Agile conferences, podcaster, and blog author on best management practices. Mentor at such programs as “Mamo Pracuj w IT” or “Tech Leaders”. Since 2013 in IT, and for several years also in the tax industry. Passionate about new technologies, psychology, and business development, especially start-ups. Privately Cracovian by choice, loves cooking and eating yummy food, developing business competencies, and trying new sports.
